description: Use this when the user wants to connect this chat to their 2hives app or website account so their progress is in one place. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation.

code.description: The 8 digits shown in the 2hives app or on 2hives.com/account/assistant. Leave out to be told how to get one.

tap.description: The token from keep_progress for this conversation; leave empty if there is none.
